students experience participation in computer science and information technology in qualitatively distinct and different ways.

students' experience of participation in CS and I T can be described in three qualitatively different categories: (1) using CS and IT, (2) developing CS and IT skills, and (3) creating new knowledge and new CS and IT.
students experience participation in computer science and IT as using, participating as a continuous development, and creating new knowledge.
